title: Learning to walk with a brass band in the city
summary: He had to learn marching again in New Orleans because the country tempo was faster.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: You see, I've got a list of questions. We might as well get down to that. Let's see. Now, how did you learn how to walk with a brass band? Did you learn that in the country or the city?

Well, I'll tell you, I came here, I had to learn over again. Because in the country, we walked, you see, just a tempo, we reached in the country, we had just a little bit faster. But then after I came here, I learned how to walk. I learned how to walk all over again.
Did they play burges a little faster out there?
And they played the regular march tempo the same or fast?
